Phase 2 implemented — Gerrit change 2386 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2386), commit 10d36bdf0e60, plan-review PASS (signed).

Bound: per-ticket re-enrichment DEBOUNCE on the self-heal path. `enrich_drain._stale_digest_ids` now skips a present-stale ticket whose latest DONE_ENRICH is younger than `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min` (new LLMConfig knob, env `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_REENRICH_DEBOUNCE_MIN`, default 1440 min/24h; 0 disables → pre-fix behavior). `_collect_claims` threads `now` + `debounce_ns`. Deletes NO event → union-merge retention invariant (be8a0c0/epic 4520) preserved. First-time enrichment (no prior DONE_ENRICH) and the cert→enqueue primary path are never debounced. Added an INFO log counting debounced skips (observability, review advisory #3).

Minimal-yet-sufficient: the single fan-out chokepoint is the every-drain stale scan; all drain entrypoints (write-path event_append, push, CLI cmd_enrich, MCP-driven writes) funnel through D.drain→_collect_claims→_stale_digest_ids, so one guard covers every surface (CLI/MCP/reconciler parity confirmed). The `_finalize_claims` drift-during-enrich re-enqueue is a DISTINCT bounded path (fires only on a real edit inside a ticket's own seconds-long enrich window, has no DONE yet) — documented, intentionally not debounced (review advisory #2).

RED→GREEN held-out oracle (tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py): `test_reenrich_debounce_bounds_the_self_heal_fanout` (5 in-window drifts → DONE_ENRICH stays 1; RED pre-fix = 6), plus post-window re-enrich, first-time-never-debounced, and window=0-disables. Mutation-checked under sandbox-exec: disabling the filter flips the oracle RED. Replication: repro harness 12 drifts → 0 re-enrichment cycles / 4 retained events (pre-fix was 12 cycles / 52 events).

Gates: make lint (complexity ratchet new=0/increased=0, module-size OK — config.py held at 799 by compressing adjacent long-landed historical comments in the same DEFAULT block; the file was at the locked 800-LOC cap), make typecheck (clean), full tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py (55 passed). docs/env-vars.md regenerated.

Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before close (caused_by 8185, class plan_defect).
